notes: Variant assumption is a standing barbell Romanian deadlift with soft knees and no floor reset. Hamstrings and gluteus maximus were kept primary; erector spinae was kept secondary because RDL-specific evidence emphasizes hamstrings relative to the trunk extensors. Upper-back and hip support roles were added only where direct RDL-family EMG measured the muscle. No anatomy blockers found.
